title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距
authors: Tony Q. Fan, Yucheng Liang, Cameron Peng
abstract: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。

title: Health Sector Structural Change
title_zh: 卫生部门的结构性变革
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The U.S. health-services sector has grown both in terms of its expenditure share and relative price. Using a two-sector general equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and endogenous population, we find that relative price growth is almost entirely attributable to increasing relative sectoral markups. Demand effects from aging play only a minor role driving up prices and expenditure shares. Controlling for GE effects and rising relative markups, we estimate that health-sector TFP has grown since the 1980s at a rate greater than 1% annually, dampening relative price growth, while leading to higher health-sector output, partially driving up aggregate expenditure shares.
abstract_zh: 美国健康服务部门的支出份额和相对价格均有所增长。通过构建一个包含垄断竞争和内生人口的两部门一般均衡模型，我们发现相对价格增长几乎完全归因于部门间相对加成率的上升。老龄化带来的需求效应对价格上涨和支出份额增加的推动作用微乎其微。在控制一般均衡效应和相对加成率上升的条件下，我们估算自20世纪80年代以来，健康部门的全要素生产率年均增长率超过1%，这抑制了相对价格增长，同时促进了健康部门产出提升，并部分推高了总支出份额。

title: The distribution of reproduction during a fertility transition: declining spread of parenthood in Brazil
title_zh: 生育转变期间的生育分布：巴西父母身份扩散的下降
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Demographers have a rich understanding of the fertility transitions that have been observed in many contexts. Yet, we lack evidence to explain whether long-run declines in fertility levels are accompanied by simultaneous changes in reproductive variability. This is important because reproductive variability—the concentration and dispersion of childbearing—may help to better explain fertility trends and predict population change. We address this gap with a case study of Brazil, which is a well-known example of fertility transition, using microdata on fertility by education for cohorts born 1910–1970. We contribute by using multiple measures of variability in completed fertility, studying how these measures change during an entire transition, how they relate to cohort fertility rates, and how this evidence varies by education. Reproductive variability declines across the Brazilian fertility transition—for measures of concentration and dispersion—although this is less evident for dispersion measures that adjust for levels of children ever born. We also find considerable differences by education and evidence that several measures of variability are predictive of fertility decline, highlighting a promising avenue for future research. Moreover, our findings suggest that conclusions based on one measure of variability may only provide a partial understanding of population dynamics.
abstract_zh: 人口学家对多国背景下观察到的生育率转变已有深入理解，但长期生育率下降是否伴随生育变异性的同步变化仍缺乏证据支撑。这一问题至关重要，因为生育变异性——即生育行为的集中度与离散度——可能有助于更精准地解释生育率趋势并预测人口变动。本研究以巴西为典型案例（该国是生育率转变的著名范例），利用1910-1970年出生队列按教育程度划分的生育微观数据填补这一空白。我们通过多重指标测量终身生育率的变异性，考察这些指标在整个转变过程中的变化规律、与队列生育率的关联性，以及不同教育群体间的差异。研究发现：巴西生育率转变期间，生育变异性（包括集中度与离散度指标）整体呈下降趋势，但经调整终身生育水平后的离散度指标变化不明显。不同教育群体间存在显著差异，且多项变异性指标对生育率下降具有预测作用，这为未来研究指明了重要方向。此外，研究结果表明，仅基于单一变异性指标得出的结论可能仅能部分反映人口动态全貌。

title: The Fentanyl Shock: Synthetic Opioids and the Supply of Organ Donors
title_zh: 芬太尼冲击：合成阿片类药物与器官捐赠者供给
authors: Omar Martin Fieles-Ahmad, Selina Schulze Spuentrup
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how the diffusion of illicit synthetic opioids affected the supply of deceased organ donors in the United States after 2012. As fentanyl spread rapidly from east to west, it produced sharp, uneven increases in overdose mortality across states. We first study the arrival of fentanyl as a dichotomous shock in a difference-in-differences framework at the organ procurement organization (OPO) level, contrasting regions east and west of the Mississippi River due to drug-market segmentation. We then turn to the intensive margin using a state-level IV approach that leverages the westward diffusion of fentanyl over time, with exposure measured using fentanyl mortality. Both approaches show that fentanyl exposure caused large increases in overdose-driven donor supply and transplanted organs, revealing how a lethal epidemic reshaped the availability of transplantable organs.

title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
title_zh: 大学贷款与人力资本投资
authors: Chao Fu, Hsuan‐Chih (Luke) Lin, Atsuko Tanaka
abstract: College loans facilitate access to education, but the repayment burden may distort posteducation human capital investment. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model of individuals' dynamic decisions on borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment. We estimate two versions of the model using data from NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income‐driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare; accounting for lifetime income taxes, they also increase government revenue.
abstract_zh: 大学贷款有助于促进教育机会获取，但还款负担可能扭曲毕业后的教育人力资本投资。我们通过构建个体在借贷/储蓄、劳动供给及有成本人力资本投资方面的动态决策结构模型，考察了大学贷款及贷款还款政策的作用机制。基于NLSY79数据，我们估计了两种模型版本：一种采用自然借贷约束，另一种采用参数化约束。反事实模拟表明，相较于标准固定还款计划，收入驱动型还款计划能适度提升教育成就、终身收入及个人福利；在考虑终身所得税后，该计划还能增加政府财政收入。
